title: text should be improved
symptom: The term 'hw data source' is confusing for users, especially parents who have just installed the software. The issue suggests renaming it to something more user-friendly like 'sensor type' or 'sensor device'. Additionally, 'librealarm' should be extended to 'librealarm/manual scan' or similar.
evidence_quote: One of the first term that our users will meet is "hw data source". "hw data source" is a very exact term for the developer writing the code, but has nothing to do with the parent who has just installed the software.
